## Data download

The data were downloaded from <https://www.naturalista.uy/observations/export> using the following parameters
`quality_grade=any&identifications=any&place_id=12416&verifiable=true`.  

```{r}
#| label: libraries
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(patchwork)
library(janitor)
library(plotly)
library(lubridate)
library(tmap)
tmap_mode('view')
library(sf)
sf_use_s2(FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| label: inat-data
#| warning: false
#| message: false

natuy_mdeo <- read_csv('data/observations-536732.csv')
```

```{r}
#| label: geo-data
#| warning: false
#| message: false

uruguay <- geodata::gadm(country = 'UY', level = 1, path = 'data/') %>% st_as_sf()
montevideo <- uruguay %>% filter(NAME_1 == 'Montevideo') %>% st_transform(32721)
```

### Taxonomic

```{r}
#| label: taxa-summary
#| warning: false
#| message: false

natuy_mdeo %>% 
  group_by(iconic_taxon_name) %>% 
  summarise(observations=n(), 
            species=n_distinct(taxon_species_name)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(observations)) %>% 
  janitor::adorn_totals() %>% 
  kableExtra::kbl(format.args = list(decimal.mark = '.', 
                                     big.mark = ','),
                  digits=2,
                  booktabs = T) %>% 
  kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = c('striped', 'hold_position'))
```

### Users

```{r}
#| label: data-observers
#| echo: false
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false

mean_observations <- natuy_mdeo %>% 
    group_by(user_login) %>%
    summarise(n_records = n()) %>% 
    summarise(mean_n_records = mean(n_records),
              sd_n_records = sd(n_records))

mean_species <- natuy_mdeo %>% 
  filter(!is.na(taxon_species_name)) %>% 
    group_by(user_login) %>%
    summarise(n_species = n_distinct(taxon_species_name)) %>% 
    summarise(mean_n_species = mean(n_species),
              sd_n_species = sd(n_species))
```


### Aportes

Each person loaded on average **`r round(mean_observations$mean_n_records,1)`** (+- `r round(mean_observations$sd_n_records,1)`) records and reported **`r round(mean_species$mean_n_species,1)`** (+- `r round(mean_species$sd_n_species,1)`) species.

```{r}
#| label: users-summary
#| warning: false
#| message: false

natuy_mdeo %>% 
  group_by(user_login) %>% 
  summarise(observations=n(), 
            species=n_distinct(taxon_species_name)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(observations)) %>% 
  # janitor::adorn_totals() %>% 
  mutate('#' = row_number()) %>% 
  relocate('#') %>% 
  slice_head(n = 10) %>% 
  kableExtra::kbl(format.args = list(decimal.mark = '.', 
                                     big.mark = ','),
                  digits=2,
                  booktabs = T) %>% 
  kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = c('striped', 'hold_position'))

ggplotly(natuy_mdeo %>% 
  group_by(user_login) %>% 
  summarise(observations=n(), 
            species=n_distinct(taxon_species_name)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(observations)) %>% 
  mutate(observations_q = case_when(observations <= 1 ~ '1',
                                    observations <= 10 ~ '<10',
                                    observations > 10 & observations <= 100 ~ '10 - 100',
                                    observations > 100 & observations <= 500 ~ '100 - 500',
                                    observations > 500 ~ '>500',
                                    .default = NA)) %>% 
  mutate(observations_q = factor(observations_q,
                                 levels =c('1', '<10','10 - 100','100 - 500','>500'))) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = observations_q, fill = observations_q)) + 
  geom_histogram(stat='count', show.legend = F) + 
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = 'Set1', direction = 1) +
  labs(x = 'Number of records per user', y='Frequency') + 
  ggpubr::theme_pubclean())
```

### Geographic

```{r}
#| label: geo-summary
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

natuy_mdeo_sf <- natuy_mdeo %>% 
    st_as_sf(coords = c('longitude', 'latitude')) %>% 
    st_set_crs(4326) %>% 
  st_transform(32721)

map_observations <- natuy_mdeo_sf %>%
  mutate(observation_id = as.character(id)) %>%
  select(observation_id, 
         taxon_name=scientific_name,
         geoprivacy,
         # taxon_rank,
         iconic_taxa = iconic_taxon_name,
         user_login, 
         observed_on) %>% 
  mutate(iconic_taxa = case_when(
    iconic_taxa == 'Mammalia' ~ 'Mamíferos',
    iconic_taxa == 'Aves' ~ 'Aves',
    iconic_taxa == 'Reptilia' ~ 'Reptiles',
    iconic_taxa == 'Animalia' ~ 'Otros animales',
    iconic_taxa == 'Amphibia' ~ 'Anfibios',
    iconic_taxa == 'Actinopterygii' ~ 'Peces con aletas radiadas',
    iconic_taxa == 'Arachnida' ~ 'Arácnidos',
    iconic_taxa == 'Insecta' ~ 'Insectos',
    iconic_taxa == 'Mollusca' ~ 'Moluscos',
    iconic_taxa == 'Chromista' ~ 'Chromista',
    iconic_taxa == 'Plantae' ~ 'Plantas',
    iconic_taxa == 'Fungi' ~ 'Hongos',
    iconic_taxa == 'Protozoans' ~ 'Protozoarios',
    .default = NA))
```

### Temporal 

```{r}
#| label: temporal-summary
#| warning: false
#| message: false


detectPeriod <- function(datos, timecol){
  
  period_timecol <- datos %>% 
    mutate(timecol=as_datetime(eval(parse(text = timecol)))) %>% 
    summarise(start=min(timecol, na.rm=T),
              end=max(timecol, na.rm=T),
              hours_active=time_length(interval(start, end), 'hours'),
              days_active=time_length(interval(start, end), 'days'),
              years_active=time_length(interval(start, end), 'years'))
  
  if(period_timecol$days_active<=2){
    periodVariables <- tibble(timecol = timecol,
                              count_variable = 'records_per_hour',
                              unit_variable = '1 hour',
                              unit_text = 'hora')
  } else if(period_timecol$days_active>2 &
            period_timecol$days_active<=4){
    periodVariables <- tibble(timecol = timecol,
                              count_variable = 'records_per_hour',
                              unit_variable = '6 hours',
                              unit_text = '6 horas')
  } else if(period_timecol$days_active>4 &
            period_timecol$days_active<=7){
    periodVariables <- tibble(timecol = timecol,
                              count_variable = 'records_per_day',
                              unit_variable = '1 day',
                              unit_text = 'día')
  }else if(period_timecol$days_active>7 &
            period_timecol$days_active<=365){
    periodVariables <- tibble(timecol = timecol,
                              count_variable = 'records_per_week',
                              unit_variable = '1 week',
                              unit_text = 'semana')
  } else if(period_timecol$days_active>365 &
            period_timecol$days_active<=730){
    periodVariables <- tibble(timecol = timecol,
                              count_variable = 'records_per_month',
                              unit_variable = '1 month',
                              unit_text = 'mes')
  }
  else{
    periodVariables <- tibble(timecol = timecol,
                              count_variable = 'records_per_year',
                              unit_variable = '6 months',
                              unit_text = '6 meses')
  }
  return(periodVariables)
}

periodVars <- detectPeriod(natuy_mdeo,
                           timecol = 'time_observed_at')

ggplotly(natuy_mdeo %>% 
           mutate(time_observed_at=as_datetime(time_observed_at)) %>%
           mutate(metric=case_when(
             periodVars$count_variable=='records_per_hour' ~ 
               hour(time_observed_at),
             periodVars$count_variable=='records_per_day' ~ 
               day(time_observed_at),
             periodVars$count_variable=='records_per_week' ~ 
               week(time_observed_at),
             periodVars$count_variable=='records_per_month' ~ 
               month(time_observed_at),
             periodVars$count_variable=='records_per_year' ~ 
               year(time_observed_at))) %>% 
           add_count(iconic_taxon_name, 
                     metric,
                     name=periodVars$count_variable) %>%
           mutate(time_observed_at=ceiling_date(time_observed_at,
                                                unit=periodVars$unit_variable)) %>%
           distinct(time_observed_at, .keep_all = T) %>% 
           mutate(label = paste0(
             # 'Fecha y hora de observación: ', time_observed_at, 
             'Registros cada ', periodVars$unit_text, 
             ':', 
             eval(parse(text = periodVars$count_variable)))) %>% 
           ggplot(., aes(x=time_observed_at, 
                         y=eval(parse(text = periodVars$count_variable)), 
                         group=2, text=label)) +
           geom_line(color='red', linewidth = 1.5)+
           geom_point(col="grey10", size=0.5) +
           scale_x_datetime(breaks = periodVars$unit_variable,
                            date_labels="%d\n%H:%M") +
           theme_light()+
           labs(x='', y= 'Número de observaciones') , 
         tooltip="text", 
         dynamicTicks = T) 
```
